tagline: A calm home for your daily habits
audience: Busy professionals seeking calm consistency. Mostly late 20s-40s, urban, value-driven.

copy.CONTACT_INFO_BODY: We read every note. Tell us what you're tracking, what's working, what isn't — we listen carefully and reply within two days.
copy.HERO_HEADLINE: Build lasting habits, one day at a time
copy.HERO_LEDE: BloomTrack is a calm, focused habit tracker that helps you build consistency through streaks, visual progress, and zero distractions.
copy.FEATURES_H2: Everything you need, nothing you don't
copy.FEATURES_LEDE: A focused toolkit for consistency. No social pressure, no streaks-as-stress.
copy.FEATURE_1_SUB: Watch your momentum build day by day. Never break the chain.
copy.FEATURE_2_SUB: See your consistency at a glance with a beautiful 30-day view.
copy.FEATURE_3_SUB: Current streak, longest streak, completion rate — all the stats that matter.
copy.FEATURE_4_SUB: Set custom reminder times so you never forget your daily rituals.
copy.FEATURE_5_SUB: Easy on the eyes, day or night. Follows your system or your choice.
copy.FEATURE_6_SUB: Sign in to sync your habits across devices. Your data, always safe.
copy.PROCESS_H2: Three steps to a better routine
copy.STEP_1_SUB: Add the habits you want to build — daily, specific days, or a weekly goal.
copy.STEP_2_SUB: One tap each day to log your progress. Quick, satisfying, done.
copy.STEP_3_SUB: See streaks grow, heatmaps fill in, and your consistency compound over time.
copy.TESTIMONIAL_1_QUOTE: Finally a habit app that doesn't try to be a social network. Just me and my habits.
copy.TESTIMONIAL_2_QUOTE: The streak tracking is addictive in the best way. I've been consistent for 47 days now.
copy.TESTIMONIAL_3_QUOTE: Love the heatmap. Seeing my progress visually keeps me motivated more than any badge system.
copy.TESTIMONIAL_4_QUOTE: Simple, clean, no ads. This is what every habit tracker should be. Dark mode is gorgeous too.
copy.CTA_BAND_LEDE: Join thousands of people using BloomTrack to build consistency, one day at a time.
copy.ABOUT_HEADLINE: We believe small daily acts compound into something quietly extraordinary
copy.ABOUT_LEDE: BloomTrack is built by a small team that's tired of habit apps that shout. We wanted a quiet, calm tool — and we built it for ourselves first.
copy.ABOUT_STORY_BODY: BloomTrack started as a weekend side project in 2024. The founders, both engineers tired of bloated habit apps with leaderboards and badges, wanted something quieter — a tool that just helps you stay consistent without performing for anyone. The first version had three habits and a streak counter. That was it. People loved it. Two years later we still believe a habit tracker should feel like a moleskine notebook, not a social network. Calm, personal, yours.
copy.ABOUT_VALUE_1_SUB: We don't notify, ping, or guilt you. The app is quiet on purpose.
copy.ABOUT_VALUE_2_SUB: Your data stays yours. No tracking, no ads, no selling.
copy.ABOUT_VALUE_3_SUB: Pay once, own it. We're not chasing engagement metrics.
copy.CONTACT_LEDE: Questions, feature requests, or just want to share what habits you're building? We'd love to hear from you.
